about.heading: About Me
about.intro: I am a frontend-focused full-stack software developer specialized in building UI/UX-driven SaaS products, internal platforms, and creative tools with modern web technologies.
about.body: I bring a disciplined, detail-oriented approach with a strong focus on collaboration and continuous improvement. I particularly enjoy working on complex interfaces, internal tools, and products where design and engineering decisions directly impact real users.
skills: Modern Frontend Engineering (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js)
Data-Driven Product & Internal Tooling (dashboards, reporting, admin workflows)
Product-Centered UX Implementation (from CLI flows to complex web UIs)
Collaboration with Product, Design, and Engineering Stakeholders
Media & Audio-Focused Interfaces (waveform players, sound libraries, rich content layouts)
